youtube_title: Same Bro Games #22: How Many Triangles Can You Count? #Shorts
youtube_description:
SAME BRO GAMES #22. Count the triangles before the timer ends. Looks easy, but most people miss a few. Comment your number before the reveal!
Answer: 12. Four lines come out of the top corner, so each horizontal line makes 6 triangles (4 choose 2), and there are 2 horizontal lines: 6 x 2 = 12.
